cases.title: Hero Antimagic Trap Drains Energy
cases.mission: A42 C-first mission for trap.c:trapeffect_anti_magic's hero branch. A fresh Healer with ordinary magic energy and no antimagical equipment leaves the upstairs square, wishes an anti-magic field onto ordinary floor, steps away, then triggers it. Observe the source energy-drain path and updated Pw status; this is distinct from physical trap impacts or monster-triggered traps. The C terrain-wish name is the cmap explanation `anti-magic field` (defsym.c), not “anti magic trap.”

cases.title: Hero Dart Trap Hits Hero
cases.mission: A42 C-first overlap probe for hero-triggered trap.c:trapeffect_dart_trap. A fresh Wizard with a distinct seed moves off the upstairs tile, places a dart trap on ordinary floor by wish, steps away, then crosses it and dismisses the effect. This is substantively distinct from v10's hostile-newt-triggered arrow trap: the hero is the target and the branch creates a dart, applies hero damage/poison, and may place it on the floor.
cases.selectionRationale: A42 C-first overlap probe for hero-triggered trap.c:trapeffect_dart_trap. A fresh Wizard with a distinct seed moves off the upstairs tile, places a dart trap on ordinary floor by wish, steps away, then crosses it and dismisses the effect. This is substantively distinct from v10's hostile-newt-triggered arrow trap: the hero is the target and the branch creates a dart, applies hero damage/poison, and may place it on the floor. C outcome: C reaches the hero arm of trapeffect_dart_trap: a dart is thrown at the hero and applies the hero-hit damage/poison result. The complete local C/JS comparison matches. The case was compared with all 23 v10 cases, all unresolved older cases, and the full v6/v7 case lists; nearest causal comparisons are recorded in priorCrosswalk.

nearestBehavioralComparisons.difference: Both are projectile traps, but v10 has a monster trigger an arrow at itself; this has the hero trigger a dart trap and become the projectile target.
The v6 trap is activated by sitting and restrains the hero; this movement trigger launches a dart.
The v7 trapdoor transports a pet; this projectile trap attacks the hero.

cases.title: Hero Fire Trap Smoulders Cloak
cases.mission: Independent C-first v11 hero movement-triggered fire trap on ordinary floor. The wizard leaves the upstairs square, wishes a fire trap onto the adjacent tile, steps off, then returns to trigger it. C reports the tower of flame and cloak smouldering.
cases.selectionRationale: Independent C-first v11 hero movement-triggered fire trap on ordinary floor. The wizard leaves the upstairs square, wishes a fire trap onto the adjacent tile, steps off, then returns to trigger it. C reports the tower of flame and cloak smouldering. C outcome: C triggers the floor fire trap on the hero, prints the flame/cloak-smoulder messages, and reaches armor damage. First local mismatch: rng at zero-based segment 0 step 15, source bucket trap.c:dofiretrap hero armor-fire branch. The case was compared with all 23 v10 cases, all unresolved older cases, and the full v6/v7 case lists; nearest causal comparisons are recorded in priorCrosswalk.

cases.title: Hero Magic Trap Summons Monsters
cases.mission: C-first v11 mission for trap.c:trapeffect_magic_trap -> domagictrap fate<10. The Wizard leaves the upstairs square, wishes a magic trap onto ordinary floor, steps away, and re-enters, observing the hero-arm magic-trap outcome. cases.title: Hero Sleep Gas Trap
cases.mission: Independent C-first v11 route to the hero branch of trap.c:trapeffect_slp_gas_trap. The source terrain description is `sleeping gas trap`. The wizard dismisses startup, leaves the upstairs square, wishes the trap on ordinary floor, steps off and back onto it, then searches once to show the aftermath.
cases.selectionRationale: Independent C-first v11 route to the hero branch of trap.c:trapeffect_slp_gas_trap. The source terrain description is `sleeping gas trap`. The wizard dismisses startup, leaves the upstairs square, wishes the trap on ordinary floor, steps off and back onto it, then searches once to show the aftermath. C outcome: C triggers sleeping gas under the hero and sets trap-caused sleep/multi state. The complete local C/JS comparison matches. The case was compared with all 23 v10 cases, all unresolved older cases, and the full v6/v7 case lists; nearest causal comparisons are recorded in priorCrosswalk.
cases.cOutcome: C triggers sleeping gas under the hero and sets trap-caused sleep/multi state.

A separately bounded C confirmation run-WA4TEZ ran node scripts/record-session.mjs challenges/cases/v11/hero-sleep-gas-trap.recipe.session.json .cache/A42-independent-reruns/hero-sleep-gas-trap.session.json with exit 0; its RNG, screen, cursor and segment traces match exactly. Bounded stdout: /tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-WA4TEZ/stdout.log.

nearestBehavioralComparisons.difference: Both put the hero to sleep, but v9 quaffs a potion through potion.c; this activates sleeping gas by movement onto a floor trap.
The v6 case sits on a bear trap; this movement-triggered gas trap applies sleep.
Both enter floor traps by movement, but the earlier pit changes vertical position while gas changes the hero’s sleep timer.

cases.title: Hero Statue Trap Animates Statue
cases.mission: A42 C-first mission for hero trap.c:trapeffect_statue_trap -> activate_statue_trap. The Wizard leaves the upstairs square, wishes and drops a newt statue, then wishes a statue trap at its square, steps away, returns, and dismisses the automatic object-list pager before observing the trap result.
cases.selectionRationale: A42 C-first mission for hero trap.c:trapeffect_statue_trap -> activate_statue_trap. The Wizard leaves the upstairs square, wishes and drops a newt statue, then wishes a statue trap at its square, steps away, returns, and dismisses the automatic object-list pager before observing the trap result. cases.title: Wand Create Monster Spawns Creature
cases.mission: C-first v11 mission for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_CREATE_MONSTER). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of create monster, selects the wished item through the explicit item menu, then answers create_critters' debug-mode type prompt with `*` to choose a random monster. Retain only if C reaches the creation/discovery branch. Closest earlier monster case is v10 bugle-awakens-hostile-soldier: that wakes an already-present hostile, while this branch creates monsters through zapnodir/create_critters.
cases.selectionRationale: C-first v11 mission for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_CREATE_MONSTER). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of create monster, selects the wished item through the explicit item menu, then answers create_critters' debug-mode type prompt with `*` to choose a random monster. Retain only if C reaches the creation/discovery branch. Closest earlier monster case is v10 bugle-awakens-hostile-soldier: that wakes an already-present hostile, while this branch creates monsters through zapnodir/create_critters. C outcome: C reaches WAN_CREATE_MONSTER through zapnodir and creates a monster from the debug-selected random type prompt. The complete local C/JS comparison matches. The case was compared with all 23 v10 cases, all unresolved older cases, and the full v6/v7 case lists; nearest causal comparisons are recorded in priorCrosswalk.

cases.title: Wand Enlightenment Reports Status
cases.mission: C-first v11 case for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_ENLIGHTENMENT). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of enlightenment, then selects it with #zap; C's NODIR dispatch reaches this distinct switch arm. C calls do_enlightenment_effect(), opens WIN_MESSAGE, prints its report and subsiding message, then exercises Wisdom. Keep only after a source-reaching C record, independent byte-identical rerecord, and comparison to the earlier wand cases.

cases.title: Wand Light Room
cases.mission: C-first v11 case for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_LIGHT). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of light, then selects it with #zap; C's NODIR dispatch reaches this distinct switch arm. C runs litroom(TRUE) and lightdamage on the current room; record the light/message and any monster effects. Keep only after a source-reaching C record, independent byte-identical rerecord, and comparison to the earlier wand cases.

cases.title: Wand Stasis Freezes Level
cases.mission: C-first v11 case for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_STASIS). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of stasis, then selects it with #zap; C's NODIR dispatch reaches this distinct switch arm. C updates svl.level.flags.stasis_until with rn1(21, 10), preventing teleportation during the duration. Include a nearby monster and a short wait only if needed to make the level effect observable. Keep only after a source-reaching C record, independent byte-identical rerecord, and comparison to the earlier wand cases.
cases.selectionRationale: C-first v11 case for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_STASIS). A fresh Wizard wishes for a wand of stasis, then selects it with #zap; C's NODIR dispatch reaches this distinct switch arm. C outcome: C reaches WAN_STASIS and assigns svl.level.flags.stasis_until with rn1(21, 10), freezing level teleportation for the duration. First local mismatch: rng at zero-based segment 0 step 19, source bucket zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_STASIS) level-duration branch. The case was compared with all 23 v10 cases, all unresolved older cases, and the full v6/v7 case lists; nearest causal comparisons are recorded in priorCrosswalk.

cases.title: Wand Wishing Makes Wish
cases.mission: C-first mission for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_WISHING). A fresh neutral Wizard wishes a charged wand of wishing, selects the C-observed inventory letter o through #zap, keeps Luck nonnegative, and supplies a food-ration wish. This exercises the wand NODIR branch, makewish result, consumed charge/discovery state, and source message order. Closest earlier wish-like case v10/rub-magic-lamp enters artifact.c’s genie path; it does not enter zapnodir, consume a wand charge, or use the wand discovery contract.
cases.selectionRationale: C-first mission for zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_WISHING). A fresh neutral Wizard wishes a charged wand of wishing, selects the C-observed inventory letter o through #zap, keeps Luck nonnegative, and supplies a food-ration wish. This exercises the wand NODIR branch, makewish result, consumed charge/discovery state, and source message order. Closest earlier wish-like case v10/rub-magic-lamp enters artifact.c’s genie path; it does not enter zapnodir, consume a wand charge, or use the wand discovery contract. C outcome: C reaches the WAN_WISHING NODIR branch, consumes a charge, asks for a food-ration wish, and applies the makewish result. First local mismatch: rng at zero-based segment 0 step 21, source bucket zap.c:zapnodir(WAN_WISHING) charge/result branch. The case was compared with all 23 v10 cases, all unresolved older cases, and the full v6/v7 case lists; nearest causal comparisons are recorded in priorCrosswalk.

nearestBehavioralComparisons.difference: Both histories use wizard wish setup, but v10’s post-wish action applies an artifact and enters artifact.c:touch_artifact; this zaps a charged wand, enters zapnodir/makewish, consumes charge, and creates a ration.
Both may grant a wish, but v10 uses a lamp/genie route; this enters the wand charge/discovery contract and zapnodir.
The earlier scroll creates a monster through read.c; this wand asks the wish parser for an object and consumes a wand charge.
